IC.IC1: Currently smoke at least ten cigarettes a day
IC.IC2: Have been smoking for at least one year
IC.IC3: Meet criteria for schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, or another psychotic disorder based on structured clinical interview
IC.IC4: Can speak and write fluent conversational English
IC.IC5: Are between 18 and 70 years of age
IC.IC6: Are willing to make a smoking cessation attempt
IC.IC7: Score 26 or higher on the Montreal Cognitive Assessment
